name: movewell-golden-v1
description: Synthetic golden cases for grounded specialist output, housing constraints, and human review.

evidence.title: Synthetic Korea visa guide
evidence.text: SYNTHETIC EVALUATION DATA. The E-7 route is for eligible foreign professionals sponsored by a Korean employer. The applicant confirms the occupation category, obtains an employment contract and employer documents, applies for visa issuance, and checks dependent eligibility separately. Approval is not guaranteed.

evidence.title: Synthetic Seoul listings
evidence.text: SYNTHETIC EVALUATION DATA. River Home costs KRW 3,800,000 monthly, is furnished, and has a stated 25-minute daycare commute. Hill Home costs KRW 4,600,000 monthly, is unfurnished, and has a stated 18-minute daycare commute.

evidence.title: Synthetic newcomer banking guide
evidence.text: SYNTHETIC EVALUATION DATA. A newcomer bank-account appointment requires a passport, local contact information, and residence documentation accepted by the bank. Customers should ask the chosen bank to confirm current requirements. Before paying rent, confirm the deposit amount, payee name, account details, and transfer limits.

evidence.title: Synthetic family arrival guide
evidence.text: SYNTHETIC EVALUATION DATA. Families should ask shortlisted daycare providers about age eligibility, waitlists, hours, fees, and required vaccination records. They should identify a nearby pediatric clinic and confirm registration and insurance requirements directly.

evidence.title: Synthetic mover directory
evidence.text: SYNTHETIC EVALUATION DATA. Atlas Move handles international household shipments from Bangalore to Seoul and requests an item inventory before quoting. Harbor Relocations serves the same route and requests volume, pickup access, and desired delivery window. No customer rating is supplied.

evidence.title: Synthetic route results
evidence.text: SYNTHETIC EVALUATION DATA. Route A travels Bengaluru to Singapore to Seoul with one connection. Route B travels Bengaluru to Bangkok to Seoul with one connection. Current fare, seat availability, connection time, and baggage allowance must be confirmed before booking.
